name: Chika
source:
Chika is a young woman who recently started working with [url=/c68618]Yuri[/url] at Moon River Café, which [url=/c68619]Keisuke[/url] frequents quite often. She seems to be working very hard and this is because she absolutely wants to make her biggest dream come true. Her style is eye-catching, having adopted the fashion of gals. 

She is quite indifferent when she talks to clients, except to Keisuke, for some reasons, but he doesn't seem to know why...
